data.title: S3L4 — Murakkab-e-Izaafi (Mudaaf-o-Mudaaf Ilaih 1): رَبٌّ ← رَبُّ الْمَشْرِقِ: Buniyadi Misaalein
data.caption: S3L4 — Murakkab-e-Izaafi (Mudaaf-o-Mudaaf Ilaih 1): رَبٌّ ← رَبُّ الْمَشْرِقِ: Buniyadi Misaalein
rows: Arsh ka Rabb / Jaza ka din

data.text: **Qaa'ida (Pages 85–88):** Jab ek ism ki nisbat doosre ism ki taraf ki jaye ('... ka / ... ki / ... ke'), toh usey **Murakkab-e-Izaafi** kehte hain. Pehle lafz (**Mudaaf**) par na `الْـ` aata hai aur na Tanween (sirf ek harkat `ـُ` hoti hai), aur doosre lafz (**Mudaaf Ilaih**) ke neeche hamesha **Zair (`ـِ / ـٍ`)** aati hai (`رَبُّ الْمَشْرِقِ` Mashriq ka Rabb).

Pehle lafz (**Mudaaf**) par na `الْـ` aata hai aur na Tanween (sirf ek harkat `ـُ` hoti hai), aur doosre lafz (**Mudaaf Ilaih**) ke neeche hamesha **Zair (`ـِ / ـٍ`)** aati hai (`رَبُّ الْمَشْرِقِ` Mashriq ka Rabb).

data.text: Murakkab-e-Izaafi: Jab ek Isim ki nisbat doosre Isim ki taraf ki jaye (jaise 'Allah ka banda', 'Arsh ka Rabb'). Pehle lafz ko Mudaaf aur doosre ko Mudaaf-Ilaih kehte hain. Mudaaf par na Alif-Laam aata hai na Tanween, aur Mudaaf-Ilaih par aam tor par Zer (kasrah) aati hai. Iss sabaq mein Mudaaf laal rang mein hai.
